stories.headline: The Macy's parade is postponed for the first time
stories.summary: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City was due to be held on Thanksgiving Day, 26 November. Severe weather pushed it to the following Saturday morning, 28 November. The parade was cancelled from 1942 to 1944 amid World War II, but it had never before been postponed.

stories.headline: Puerto Rico wins Miss Universe for a sixth time
stories.summary: The 75th Miss Universe pageant was held at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on 24 November. Jennifer Barreto of Puerto Rico won the competition, succeeding Fátima Bosch of Mexico. She is the first married woman and mother to win it, and the sixth titleholder from her country.

stories.headline: Fragrance makers are fined for sharing sensitive information
stories.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom have fined three fragrance manufacturers: Firmenich, Givaudan and International Flavors & Fragrances. The companies exchanged commercially sensitive information between 2019 and 2023. The fines total more than €570 million.

stories.headline: A Pakistani astronaut reaches China's space station
stories.summary: Shenzhou 24 launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on 25 November and docked with the Tiangong space station at 03:56 UTC. It is carrying the Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani to reach orbit, for a one-week visit. Its commander, Tang Hongbo, is the first Chinese astronaut to visit the station three times.

sources.excerpt: While 2024 marked the 100th anniversary of the first parade, its 100th edition is set to be held in 2026 since the parade was canceled from 1942 to 1944 amid World War II; materials required for the balloons were instead used for war efforts.
However, the 2026 parade was postponed to the Saturday after Thanksgiving due to severe weather, marking the first time in history that the parade has been postponed.
This caused Macy's to move the parade from Thanksgiving Day, November 26, to the following Saturday morning, November 28, 2026.
The Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City is postponed to Saturday, November 28, 2026 due to thunderstorms.
Miss Universe 2026 was the 75th Miss Universe pageant, held at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico, on 24 November 2026.
Jennifer Barreto of Puerto Rico won the competition, succeeding Fátima Bosch of Mexico.
Barreto is the first married woman and mother to win the competition, as well as the sixth titleholder from her country and the first since Zuleyka Rivera in 2006.

The European Union and United Kingdom impose fines totalling more than €570 million (US$626 million) on fragrance manufacturers Firmenich, Givaudan, and International Flavors & Fragrances for exchanging commercially sensitive information between 2019 and 2023.

Shenzhou 24 launched aboard a Long March 2F/G rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on 25 November 2026, at 00:18:52 UTC (08:18:52 CST, local time at the launch site). The spacecraft docked with the forward port of the Tianhe core module of Tiangong at 03:56 UTC.
The mission is carrying Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali to Tiangong for a one-week visit, making him the first Pakistani to reach orbit.
The mission is commanded by Tang Hongbo, who previously flew to Tiangong on Shenzhou 12 and Shenzhou 17, making him the first Chinese astronaut to visit the station three times.
